messages:
neel: Clearing out my little home office next weekend — a few freebies and cheap swaps. Pick up Hayes Valley on Sunday. Photos in this album: https://imgur.com/a/xyZ9Q7k

Items available:
- IKEA Markus chair (black) 303c light wear on armrest but solid.
- Varidesk laptop stand (converter) 50x30cm, fits dual monitors with clamp.
- Logitech MX Keys (wired + USB dongle) 50% battery left, minor key shine.
- TaoTronics Soundbar (Bluetooth + AUX) 50W, great for video calls.
- 2x SF Giants tickets (lower bowl) for Tue 7pm 50 have to go together, free if you take the soundbar too.

Pickup: Sunday 11:002:30, near Gough & Fell. DM me to claim items and I'll hold for 1hr. Can meet earlier on request. No shipping.

devon: Interested in the Markus. Any lumbar support?

neel: Yep, adjustable tilt and built-in lumbar. Im 5'10" and it was fine. No major stains. Photo of tag + wear: https://imgur.com/markus-tag

amira: Ooh, Giants tix! Cant make Tues but can pick them up and pass to someone else. Will trade for the Varidesk?

neel: Amira, sure — if you take the Varidesk + tix together I'll consider that a win. DM to confirm.

ops-bot: Heads up: do not post private payment links in this channel. Use DMs or the payments channel. :shield:

gabe: I can grab the MX Keys and dongle. Can you confirm it's the older model with the black case?

neel: Yep older case, has USB-A dongle. I'll hold it until 10:45 on Sunday.

riley: If no one claims the soundbar, i'll take it and the tickets — been trying to go to a game. Can you hold both until 12:15?\\neel: Riley, holding both for you until 12:15. Priority to Amira if she confirms the Varidesk+tix swap by 09:00 Sat.

devon: Quick q: does the Varidesk have the small clamp or is it the freestanding riser?

neel: It's the clamp version. Screws + clamp are in the box. I used it on a 48" desk.

amira: Confirmed! I'll take Varidesk + tix. Will DM details and can swing by at 11:30. Thanks :)

gabe: Venmo sent $10 for the keys — @gabe (keyboard).

neel: Gabe received, thanks.

riley: I can still take the soundbar if Amira wants the tix only. Let me know.

neel: All items tentatively spoken for: Markus -> devon, Varidesk+tix -> amira, MX Keys -> gabe, Soundbar -> riley (conditional). If anything falls through I'll post an update. Thanks y'all! :tada:
